paper_statement: The order-1/n correction to the layer-(l+1) NTK mean is generated by exactly five admissible Feynman diagrams: two with quadratic K{1} and Theta{1} vertices and three with quartic V, D, and F vertices.
assumptions: MLP and NTK parameterization of Appendix B
Section 4 vertex and propagator selection rules
pass_condition: The rule enumerator produces exactly the five unique topologies and paper coefficients; an independent structural checker passes; dropping the F vertex makes the verifier exit nonzero.
